revision_policy: Downstream website work may refine selection, wording, grouping, and presentation while preserving accepted compatibility boundaries and source traceability.
identity_note: Compatibility profiles and tool bundles are Crystal Lattice implementations, not official upstream applications or sessions.

features.title: Product features
features.description: Complete per-plugin application and session feature rows that are not repeated in the provider or model-family tool tables. Publication work may later shorten descriptions or hide review-only columns.

rows.description: Provides application-level actions to request a complete application reload and to update explicitly allowlisted provider keys in a configured dotenv file.
rows.limitations: Process environment is externally managed; secret input does not prove exhaustive log/cache/history redaction.

rows.description: Cloud agent application plugin and managed SSH transfer adapter.
rows.limitations: No Docker, orchestrator, SSH, transfer, cloud link, deployment, or produced runtime executed.

rows.description: Generic, provider-agnostic cost tracking plugin for the Crystal Lattice platform.
rows.limitations: Provider-reported or locally estimated values are not invoices; availability differs by route.

rows.description: Generic, provider-agnostic duration tracking plugin for the Crystal Lattice platform.
rows.limitations: Not selected in checked-in default; distinct from selected timestamp message-duration metadata.

rows.description: Feature plugin providing `@file:` marker expansion and file completions.
rows.limitations: No dedicated mobile/desktop completion UI established; inserted content has ordinary prompt/history privacy risk.

rows.description: Feature plugin that merges `request_options` from config into the provider payload, with support for declarative UI configuration using flat override keys.
rows.limitations: Schema exposure does not prove upstream provider accepts every option or model is available.

rows.description: Feature plugin providing configurable system-message templating for request-time prompt composition.
rows.limitations: Interactive terminal and standalone CLI/Python have no generic session-action executor; terminal request composition/history rendering still applies. Compiled text can contain sensitive project context.

rows.description: Feature plugin providing `@web:` marker expansion and URL completions.
rows.limitations: No remote fetch was run; URL safety, reachability, and extraction success are unverified.

rows.description: Application-level plugin for generating session titles (and descriptions).
rows.limitations: Default model override availability/entitlement unknown; generation can race with message changes.

rows.description: Optional application actions for exporting messages or sessions as Markdown, PDF, EPUB/Kindle-compatible files, and generated session assets.
rows.limitations: Not selected by default; no generic terminal action execution; conversion/browser/pandoc/SMTP/Keychain/native-share workflows not completed.

rows.description: Application-level plugin to rebuild provider-native history from core messages.
rows.limitations: No automatic snapshot policy in this action; provider-native representation remains provider-specific.

rows.description: Application-level plugin providing copy/fork/delete session actions.
rows.limitations: No generic terminal action runner established; unknown-agent deletion and concurrency edges need resolution.

rows.description: Application-level plugin that archives and restores sessions.
rows.limitations: Default filter changes visible membership; generic client support is not native UI verification.

rows.description: Generic application-level actions for downloading session-owned attachment assets.
rows.limitations: Generic storage/download does not mean every provider accepts attachments; terminal/headless workflow not established.

rows.description: Application plugin that contributes the ordinary declarative main search and focused text filters for session lists.
rows.limitations: Does not search all messages or assistant/tool content; client fallback omits first_user_message; no server full-text endpoint.

rows.description: Application-level plugin that computes message-count fields for sessions.
rows.limitations: Derived count, not separately persisted; generic client metadata rendering is source/test bounded.

rows.description: Application-level plugin defining bucketed ordering for session lists.
rows.limitations: Ordering is time-sensitive and plugin-derived; no arbitrary user sort control established.

rows.description: Application-level plugin that toggles and filters pinned state on sessions.
rows.limitations: No generic terminal action execution; native UI suites not run.

rows.description: Application-level plugin for assigning and filtering session workflow status.
rows.limitations: Application adds public order metadata that one plugin test does not expect; workflow status is distinct from request execution status.

rows.description: Application-level plugin that computes timestamp-derived fields for sessions and contributes the `modified_after` timezone-aware session-list filter.
rows.limitations: Derived projection; fallback/time-bound behavior can change without metadata mutation.

rows.description: Application-level plugin providing actions and UI schema for editing session titles.
rows.limitations: Event-store test drift is not title behavior proof; generic terminal action execution unknown.

rows.description: Application plugin that exposes a live server setting for keeping the local server process awake.
rows.limitations: Not selected by default; no real OS hold or native client workflow run.

rows.description: Application-level plugin providing summarize-range session actions.
rows.limitations: No hosted summarization result; action does not itself establish a recovery snapshot.

rows.description: Timing-related feature plugins.
rows.limitations: Distinct from optional duration-tracking reports and human-time telemetry.
